analysis.summary: Krishana Phoschem Limited reported Q1 FY27 revenue from operations of ₹532 crore, reflecting a 35% year-on-year growth, and EBITDA of ₹89 crore. Fertilizer production reached 89,747 metric tonnes, with capacity utilization standing at 43% for the NPK-DAP unit and 121% for the SSP unit. Management expects to achieve 30%-35% turnover growth over the previous year and achieve a quarterly revenue of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27. Raw material supply issues experienced in Q1 have smoothened, positioning the company for higher capacity utilization. Krishana Phoschem Limited presented its Q1 FY27 financial results, reporting revenue growth of 34.58% YoY to ₹532.3 crore and Profit After Tax growth of 53.88% YoY to ₹47.06 crore.

guidance.claim: The company expects to achieve an additional 30%–35% turnover over the previous year as production smoothens in the remaining quarters.
guidance.quote: We are hoping that over the remaining quarters, we will be able to smoothen our production, and we will be able to achieve an additional 30%–35% turnover over last year.

guidance.claim: Management expects to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27.
guidance.quote: We expect to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27, supported by improved capacity utilization and production.

guidance.claim: Management expects Krishana Phoschem to achieve over 40% growth across key parameters in the current year.
guidance.quote: Accordingly, we expect to deliver growth of over 40% across key parameters during the current year.

guidance.claim: The company expects overall revenue growth of 35% to 40% in FY27.
guidance.quote: So overall, we hope 35%-40% revenue growth in FY27.

guidance.claim: For FY27, the company projects importing around 150,000 metric tons of material, generating approximately Rs. 1,000 crore in revenue.
guidance.quote: For FY27, based on market demand, we expect to import around 150,000 metric tons of material, which would translate into approximately Rs.1,000 crore of revenue.

demand_outlook.claim: Industry-wide production dropped by 28% year-on-year while SSP production declined by around 7% during April-May 2026.
demand_outlook.quote: During the April-May 2026 period, industry-wide production declined by 28% year-on-year, while SSP production dropped by around 7% year-on-year.

demand_outlook.claim: Monsoon revival in early July accelerated fertilizer offtake across several key markets for the Kharif season.
demand_outlook.quote: However, rainfall improved materially during early July, resulting in a rapid recovery in sowing progress, improved farmer sentiment, and accelerated fertilizer offtake across several key markets for the remainder of the Kharif season.

demand_outlook.claim: The quarter ended March 2026 experienced stable demand dynamics during the Rabi season.
demand_outlook.quote: On the Rabi season, the quarter ended March ‘26, witnessed stable demand dynamics during the Rabi season.

demand_outlook.claim: Fertilizer demand is expected to remain stable supported by high water levels in reservoirs and rivers and a near-normal monsoon forecast.
demand_outlook.quote: Therefore, we do not expect any stress on the agriculture sector, and consequently, fertilizer demand is expected to remain stable.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is evaluating capacity expansion opportunities that are pending board approval and statutory disclosures.
capex_expansion.quote: We are currently evaluating certain capacity expansion opportunities.

capex_expansion.claim: Detailed capex plans will be disclosed publicly once proposals are finalized and approved by the board.
capex_expansion.quote: Once the proposals are finalized and approved by the Board, we will make the necessary public disclosures.

capex_expansion.claim: Expanded capacities at Meghnagar include NPK/DAP at 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid at 99,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: Our expanded capacities at Meghnagar — NPK/DAP at 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid at 99,000 MTPA — are now contributing progressively to our performance.

capex_expansion.claim: Krishana Phoschem increased its NPK/DAP capacity by 50% to 495,000 MTPA, bringing total phosphatic fertilizer capacity to 615,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: NPK/DAP capacity enhanced by 50% to 495,000 MTPA and existing SSP capacity at 120,000 MTPA, taking total phosphatic fertilizer capacity to 615,000 MTPA

capex_expansion.claim: The company strengthened backward integration by adding sulphuric acid capacity of 99,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: Backward integration strengthened with sulphuric acid capacity of 99,000 MTPA

capex_expansion.claim: The company executed a 10-year Green Ammonia Sale Agreement for 70,000 MTPA under the National Green Hydrogen Mission.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of our long-term sustainability strategy, Krishana Phoschem has entered into a 10-year Green Ammonia Sale Agreement (GASA) under India’s National Green Hydrogen Mission for 70,000 MTPA.

margins_costs.claim: Q1 FY27 EBITDA reached ₹89 crore, registering 36% year-on-year growth.
margins_costs.quote: Quarterly EBITDA stood at ₹ 89 crore, reflecting a 36% year-on-year growth, supported by disciplined cost management, despite volatility in raw material prices.

margins_costs.claim: The EBITDA margin is approximately 7%–8% for trading and around 16% for manufacturing operations.
margins_costs.quote: The EBITDA margin is approximately 7%–8% for trading and around 16% for manufacturing.

margins_costs.claim: The company has passed on approximately 25%–30% of the increase in raw material input costs.
margins_costs.quote: Overall, we have been able to pass on ~ 25%–30% of the increase in input costs.

margins_costs.claim: Quarterly revenue grew 34.58% YoY to ₹532.3 crore in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: Quaterly revenue grew 34.58% YoY to ₹532.3 crore, driven by sustained capacity utilization and efficient execution across our integrated value chain.

margins_costs.claim: Quarterly Profit After Tax grew 53.88% YoY to ₹47.06 crore in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: Quaterly Profit After Tax grew 53.88% YoY to ₹47.06 crore, reflecting improved operating efficiency and disciplined cost control.

margins_costs.claim: Q4 FY26 EBITDA stood at Rs. 90 crore, recording 59% YoY growth.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA came in at Rs.90 crore, registering a 59% YoY growth, supported by operating leverage from higher volumes and stable cost management despite input price volatility.

margins_costs.claim: Profitability is expected to moderate slightly in FY27 as the company absorbs a portion of higher input costs.
margins_costs.quote: Yes, of course, we will absorb to some extent and as a result, our profitability is expected to come down slightly during the current year FY27.

margins_costs.claim: Backward integration capabilities enable higher EBITDA margins compared to industry peers.
margins_costs.quote: Backward integration has been a key contributor, which is why our EBITDA margins are higher than peers.

orders_capacity.claim: The company achieved 43% capacity utilization in its NPK-DAP unit and 121% in its SSP unit during Q1 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: 43% capacity utilization of NPK-DAP unit and 121% capacity utilization of SSP unit, which was beyond the core.

orders_capacity.claim: Total NPK-DAP capacity reached 495,000 MT following the addition of 165,000 MT capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: Our existing NPK-DAP capacity is 330,000 MT, and we have added another 165,000 MT, taking the total capacity to 495,000 MT.

orders_capacity.claim: Fertilizer production reached 89,747 metric tonnes during the quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: Achieved fertilizer production of 89,747 metric tonnes, showcasing our consistent operational efficiency.

orders_capacity.claim: Sales volumes were 53,500 MT for NPK-DAP, 36,300 MT for SSP, and 21,000 MT for trading in Q1 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: For NPK-DAP, it was 53,500 MT, for SSP 36,300 MT

orders_capacity.claim: The company holds an installed capacity of 6.15 Lakh MTPA.
Fertilizer production reached 94,103 MT in Q4 FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Achieved fertilizer production of 94,103 MT, driven by peak Rabi season demand and improved operational throughput

orders_capacity.claim: Total fertilizer production reached 397,263 MT for full year FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Achieved total production of 397,263 MT, supported by High demand across markets

orders_capacity.claim: Certain NPK/DAP and SSP units operated above 100% capacity during Q4 FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Maintained healthy utilization across NPK/DAP and SSP plants, with certain units operating above 100% capacity, reflecting strong demand and efficient plant operations

capital_allocation.claim: The company completed a 5-for-1 stock split, reducing share face value from ₹10 to ₹2 per share.
capital_allocation.quote: Recently, the company successfully executed a 5-for-1 stock split, subdividing the face value of our equity shares from ₹ 10 per share to ₹ 2 per share.

capital_allocation.claim: Depreciation increased to ₹13 crore and finance costs rose to ₹20 crore following capacity commissioning.
capital_allocation.quote: Depreciation increased from around ₹8.7 crore to ₹13 crore, while finance costs increased from around ₹13 crore to ₹20 crore.

capital_allocation.claim: The Cabinet approved NBS rates for Kharif 2026 alongside a fertilizer subsidy outlay exceeding ₹2.4 lakh crore for FY27.
capital_allocation.quote: The Cabinet's approval of NBS rates for Kharif 2026, alongside a fertilizer subsidy outlay exceeding ₹2.4 lakh crore for FY27, underscores the government's commitment to farmer affordability & sector stability.

capital_allocation.claim: Capacity expansion projects were funded via internal accruals and term loans.
capital_allocation.quote: This expansion has been funded through a prudent mix of internal accruals and term loans, reflecting disciplined capital allocation.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's effective interest cost ranges between 6% and 7.5%.
capital_allocation.quote: Overall, the effective interest cost is in the range of 6% to 7.5%.

risks_headwinds.claim: The phosphatic industry faced global supply disruptions, high raw material prices, and geopolitical uncertainties in Q1 FY27.
risks_headwinds.quote: The 1st Quarter witnessed a challenging operating environment for the phosphatic supplier industry, primarily driven by global supply-side disruptions, elevated raw material prices, and geopolitical uncertainties.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical conflicts surrounding the Strait of Hormuz led to increased freight costs and delayed raw material vessels.
risks_headwinds.quote: Geopolitical tensions in West Asia, particularly surrounding critical shipping lanes through the Strait of Hormuz, introduced considerable uncertainty across global industry, global fertilizer supply chains during the quarter.

risks_headwinds.claim: Raw material availability was the primary operational challenge faced by the company in the first quarter.
risks_headwinds.quote: The primary challenge during the first quarter was the availability of raw materials.

risks_headwinds.claim: Sulphur price increases towards March created cost pressures in Q4 FY26 due to demand timing mismatches.
risks_headwinds.quote: Sulphur prices also firmed up towards March. This created a timing mismatch where domestic demand was slowed down in March while input costs were increasing, leading to higher cost pressure in the closing quarter.

risks_headwinds.claim: The domestic industry relies on imports for nearly 90% of key intermediates, exposing cost structures to global price trends.
risks_headwinds.quote: Given the industry's reliance on imports for ~90% of key intermediates, these global movements had a direct impact on cost structure.

risks_headwinds.claim: Government subsidy support under the NBS framework provides relief but does not entirely cover recent input cost increases.
risks_headwinds.quote: While the support announced does not fully offset the increase in input costs, it does provide meaningful relief.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects quarterly turnover to exceed ₹500 crore over each of the remaining three quarters of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We expect to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27, supported by improved capacity utilization and production.

management_commitments.claim: The 70,000 MTPA green ammonia supply capacity arrangement will begin operations in FY29 after 2 years.
management_commitments.quote: And this capacity will start in FY29 after 2 years.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets 35% to 40% overall revenue growth for FY27.
management_commitments.quote: So overall, we hope 35%-40% revenue growth in FY27.

management_commitments.claim: Management anticipates profitability to decline slightly during FY27 due to partial absorption of raw material cost increases.
management_commitments.quote: Yes, of course, we will absorb to some extent and as a result, our profitability is expected to come down slightly during the current year FY27.

management_commitments.claim: Green ammonia supply under the long-term contract is expected to begin after approximately three years.
management_commitments.quote: As per the contract, the green ammonia plant is expected to commence operations in the third year, so we expect supply after approximately three years.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
